overview: I spent just over a year at Serv5 in Mansoura, working on-site on client web and mobile projects. I started on the back end with Laravel and moved into full-stack work in July 2022, adding Vue.js front ends to the PHP back ends I already knew.

roles.title: Full Stack Engineer
roles.details: In July 2022 I moved into a full-stack role, building features end to end, from API endpoints in PHP to Vue.js interfaces for client-facing apps. I kept working on performance across both layers, supported production systems with maintenance and fixes, and introduced tooling that automated parts of the team's development workflow.
responsibilities: Built and maintained web applications across the front end and back end, using Vue.js and PHP
Developed features end to end, from API endpoints to user-facing interfaces
Improved web app performance and responsiveness
Supported production systems with maintenance and issue resolution

roles.title: Back End Developer
roles.details: I joined Serv5 as a back-end developer, working across several web and mobile projects at once. Most of my time went into Laravel: building and integrating the APIs behind the company's mobile apps, optimising slow parts of existing applications, and refactoring legacy code to current Laravel standards. I also handled after-sales technical support, helping clients with issues once their projects were live.
responsibilities: Contributed to multiple web and mobile projects, with a focus on back-end development and stability
Built and integrated APIs to power mobile applications
Improved web app performance through optimization work
Maintained and refactored code, and resolved production issues
Provided after-sales technical support to clients
